Measles Case Travels Through California Counties

California health officials have issued a warning after an unvaccinated individual diagnosed with measles traveled through six counties. The person rode Amtrak trains during their travels, potentially exposing others to the highly contagious disease. The specific counties affected have not been detailed in the provided coverage.
